artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely nonsensical and structurally malformed. Characters melt into each other, have inconsistent baselines, and do not form recognizable words. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.
The right corner of the diamond sign appears slightly warped and uneven, lacking the crisp geometric precision expected of a manufactured metal sign. The border thickness varies inconsistently.
The wood grain texture on the post is somewhat repetitive and lacks fine detail, appearing slightly 'painted on' rather than naturally textured, though less severe than the text issues.
